changes: Latest-only analysis capped at four starts per second per camera; stale work dropped before model invocation.
OpenCV small-image CPU pool limited to one thread; model weights, CPU model input/thresholds and firmware frame-rate/quality unchanged.
DHT uses an independent persistent direct session with bounded timeouts, redirect refusal, response cleanup, health reporting and retry.
Browser sensor requests are single-flight with bounded timeouts; polling reschedules even after an unexpected callback failure.
DHT/thermal responses use no-store. Internal protected snapshot saves cache/timing/network diagnostics only, without images, identities, credentials or device activation.
Camera DELETE/session-expiry release clears ownership immediately and closes a stalled upstream asynchronously, without occupying a browser HTTP request until socket timeout.

benchmark_note: Generated images only; changing Torch threads did not show a material inference gain, so no Torch-thread override was installed.
